[[Marnta Doomspeaker]] is a [[Monk]] [[boss]] found in [[Snake Dance]]. Next to Marnta Doomspeaker stands the [[Nightmare]] boss [[Cry Darkday]].

== Notes ==
* It is easier to kill Marnta Doomspeaker if you first kill [[Cry Darkday]], with whom she is always found; the other boss otherwise provides her with almost unlimited energy. 
* She is one of the few enemies in the game who does not have a conventional [[attack]]; she wields only an [[off-hand]] item.
* Unlike most bosses in the [[region]], Marnta Doomspeaker is always found in the same location — a small cirque or corner near Camp Rankor.

== Trivia ==
* Marnta Doomspeaker looks like a [[Xunlai Agent]].
